title: Open a deal and move it to Won

steps.do: Left menu → Sales → Opportunities → "+ New opportunity".

What is the opportunity? "Refinery shutdown TPI 2026", Customer = TB Refinery Ltd, Pipeline = default, Estimated value ₹12,00,000, Expected close next month, Branch Ahmedabad, Where it came from = An existing customer, Competing against "Bureau X", Contact "Mr Patel", Next action "Site visit", By when tomorrow → "Open the opportunity".
steps.expect: The deal opens with tabs Overview · Quotes · Actions · History at the first stage.
steps.observed: Opened at "Enquiry received" with tabs Overview · Quotes · History · Actions.
steps.note: After the first move a History tab does appear (Overview · Quotes · History · Actions); it is missing only while the deal has never moved.

steps.do: Actions tab → "Move it to" = Quotation sent (50%) → "Move it".

steps.expect: Message "Won — TB Refinery Ltd said yes. Next: on the Actions tab, send it to Accounts to register the contract." Banner "Won — TB Refinery Ltd said yes. 🎉" with the same next step, and the Actions tab offers "Send to Accounts to register the contract" (owner, 12 Nov 2026: the old message contradicted the banner).
steps.observed: "Won — TB Refinery Ltd said yes. Next: on the Actions tab, send it to Accounts to register the contract." Banner "Won — TB Refinery Ltd said yes. 🎉"; Actions offers "Send to Accounts to register the contract".

steps.expect: Won value includes ₹12,00,000; "Who is selling" credits Test BDM.
steps.observed: Won value shows ₹12 L; "Who is selling": "Test BDM 0 ₹0 1 ₹12,00,000 0".
